body.name: Bonferroni--Fieller inversion
body.construction: For each \(t\in\mathcal B\), \(\mathcal F_t=\{u\in\mathbb R:n(\widehat m_t-u\widehat p_t)^2\le z_{1-\alpha_0/16}^2\widehat{\operatorname{Var}}(\phi_{m,t}-u\phi_{p,t})\}\); the simultaneous Walsh region is \(H(\prod_{t\in\mathcal B}\mathcal F_t)\).
